花「あら　うれしい！

花「でね　一番おもしろかったのは

花「ギーガっていうおじいさんが
　あそこの墓地に　おりて行ったときね。
花「ギーガっていう人は　たしか・・・

花「ドラゴンを　たおして
　みんなを　たすけてあげたんでしょ？
花「なのに人間ったら　つぎはカレを
　バケモノだって　言いだして・・・。
花「あのときは　さすがのアタシも
　キレちゃったわよ。
花「まあ　アタシは花だからさ

花「キレたっていっても
　べつに　どうってことないんだけどね。
花「でもね　しばらくしたら
　人間っていいなぁって　思いなおしたわ。
花「お墓まいりに　行く人がね
　前にくらべて　ふえたのよ。
花「これって　どういことかわかる？

花「何だかんだ言っても

花「村の人たちは　ギーガさんを
　英雄だって　思ってるってこと。
花「そうじゃなければ　あのお墓は
　とっくに　使われなくなってるだろうし
花「そのそばに住もうなんて思わない。
　ね・・・そうでしょ？
花「・・・・・・。

花「なんか　ひさしぶりに
　人間とおしゃべりして　たのしかったよ。
花「そのお礼といっちゃなんだけど
　これ　あんたにあげるよ。
{unclassified-control:14}@A@{unclassified-control:7e}は
{unclassified-control:14}小さなメダルを手に入れた！
花「あんたみたいな人間ばっかりだと

花「アタシも　はりきって
　もっときれいな花さかせるんだけどね。
花「・・・ふふふ。

花「それじゃあ　またね。
entries.english:
Flower: Oh, lovely!

Flower: The most interesting thing was when an old man called Giga went down into that cemetery.

Flower: Giga... He defeated the dragon and saved everyone, didn't he?

Flower: But then the humans began calling him a monster...

Flower: Even I lost my temper at that.

Flower: Well, I'm a flower. Losing my temper doesn't really do much.

Flower: But after a while, I began to think better of humans again.

Flower: More people started visiting the graves. Do you know what that means?

Flower: Whatever they said, the villagers still thought of Giga as a hero.

Flower: Otherwise, they'd have abandoned that cemetery long ago. They wouldn't want to live beside it either.

Flower: Don't you think?

Flower: ...

Flower: It's been so long since I talked to a human. I've enjoyed this.

Flower: Here, take this as a little thank-you.

{center}@A@{player}
{center}received a Mini medal!

Flower: If all humans were like you, I'd put even more effort into blooming beautifully.

Flower: ...Hee hee.

Flower: See you again.

entries.english:
Flower: Oh, lovely!

Flower: The most interesting thing was when an old man called Giga went down into that cemetery.

Flower: Giga... He defeated the dragon and saved everyone, didn't he?

Flower: But then the humans began calling him a monster...

Flower: Even I lost my temper at that.

Flower: Well, I'm a flower. Losing my temper doesn't really do much.

Flower: But after a while, I began to think better of humans again.

Flower: More people started visiting the graves. Do you know what that means?

Flower: Whatever they said, the villagers still thought of Giga as a hero.

Flower: Otherwise, they'd have abandoned that cemetery long ago. They wouldn't want to live beside it either.

Flower: Don't you think?

Flower: ...

Flower: It's been so long since I talked to a human. I've enjoyed this.

Flower: Here, take this as a little thank-you.

{center}@A@{player}
{center}received a Mini medal!

Flower: If all humans were like you, I'd put even more effort into blooming beautifully.

Flower: ...Hee hee.

Flower: See you again.
